prompt:

Title: Voice Over needed for long 10 hour course.
NO AI VOICES, I need a real person to record a 10 hour script for an online computer training course I don't need over the top production just a casual instructional tone with basic recording equipment in a quite echo free room. My scripts for this project are transcribed from my original course with a native Indian speaker. So there are some inconsistencies in grammar and syntax that you will need to either fix before you start or fix on the fly. I've found some freelancers are better at this than others. Additionally there may be some acronyms since this is a computer training course but you will be able to refer to the original videos to help. text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working freelancer with extensive experience in Python and machine learning, and I’d love to help with this voice-over project.

I know this job is about more than just reading a script—it also requires a clear, casual instructional tone, careful handling of inconsistent grammar, and the ability to keep delivery accurate and natural. I’m comfortable working through text carefully and adapting as needed while keeping the wording clear and polished.

One relevant project I built was a clinical note summarisation system for Brightwell Clinics, where I created a LoRA-tuned Flan-T5 model to draft visit summaries after names, dates, and IDs were masked. That work achieved a ROUGE-L of 0.41 and reduced clinician editing time by 38% in a 6-week trial.

I’d be happy to record the sample line for approval. Do you want the final delivery split into smaller sections or submitted as one continuous recording?
